transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... my words aren't really staying in a straight line lately. Like, I'll try to talk about my overnight shift, and then... I don't know, suddenly I'm talking about soccer, or paint colors, or patient charts. People get lost. I can see it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually high or overly energetic lately?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't... I don't think I've felt energetic.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can't hear?
No... I don't think so. I haven't heard anything like that. Just... regular noise.
Have you been feeling like someone is trying to harm you or watch you?

Um... well... I don't know about harm. But... yeah. Watched. 

Just... at work. I know the supervisors watch me on the unit cameras. They, um... they changed my shifts around to see if I'm unsafe. People keep telling me it's just staffing shortages, but... I'm sure they're watching me.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
No... I don't think so. I'm... I'm usually pretty tired, actually. I definitely need to sleep.
Have you been feeling less interested in being around other people than you used to?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I stay in my apartment mostly. I usually just ignore messages when people reach out. I used to do stuff... play soccer on weekends, or cook for my friends... sketch murals... but... I don't know. It all just feels pointless now. I don't really want to be around anyone.
Have you had any recent seizures, head injury, or other medical illness?
No... nothing like that. I haven't been sick or hurt my head.
Have you been feeling depressed most days lately?

Yeah... most days. I just... I feel really heavy. And empty, I guess, right from when I wake up. It's... well, after my shifts, I usually just sit in my car for a while. I end up... crying, mostly... before I can even get myself to drive home.
Have there been times when you felt watched even when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah... I guess so. There was a stretch... maybe a few weeks, where I wasn't really in that... that dark place. But I still knew they were watching me. The cameras... the supervisors at work. I just... I had to be really careful. Guarded, I guess.
Has there been a time when you felt watched like this for at least two weeks while not feeling depressed at all?
Yeah... like I just said. It was a few weeks. I wasn't... I wasn't depressed then. But I still knew they were monitoring me. The cameras and the supervisors. I just... kept acting guarded at work.
About how long have these problems with your thoughts jumping around and feeling watched been going on?
I don't know exactly. A while. Maybe... a little over a year? Like a year and a month, I think. That's when I started noticing it all.
During the past year, was there ever a full month when you were not depressed at all but your thoughts were still jumping around or you still felt watched?
No... I don't think it was a whole month. Just... what I said before. A few weeks, maybe. Not a full month.
For most of the time since these problems began, have you been depressed?

Yeah... I guess so. Looking back on it... that heavy feeling, just being empty and not caring about anything... it's been there most of this whole time. Even when... even if the camera stuff or the scattered talking got a little quieter... the empty feeling was still there.
